analyst_view.overall: Levante (15th, 12 pts) host Racing Santander (7th, 17 pts) on Friday night; the numbers make it a clear home win with about 3.9 goals. Luis Castro's Levante drew 1-1 with Elche on Monday, a late Requena equaliser after Ivan Romero hit the post, so they are one point above the drop, four games without a win and get only four days' rest before Friday, which the numbers don't count. Manu Sanchez is out until June with a cruciate ligament tear (the numbers count him) and Toljan is a doubt with muscle discomfort. Jose Alberto's Racing beat Real Sociedad 3-2 on Sunday with two goals from Aaron Martin; Mantilla (season) and Maguette Gueye (hamstring, four to six weeks) are out and Andres Martin is improving but uncertain, all already counted by the numbers. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.9 goals, 2.6 of them for Levante. I stay a little lower, about 3.7, as in my earlier view: Levante's attack has been blunt (one goal against Elche, four games without a win) and they play again four days after Monday, a short turnaround the numbers don't count. Racing's injuries (Mantilla, Gueye, Andres Martin) are already taken into account, and their leaky defence keeps the lean small.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.3 corners, 7.0 for Levante. Racing concede plenty of corners (40 in their last six, 14 against Real Sociedad), which the numbers already count, and Levante under Castro attack down the wings with Brugue. Nothing new points either way, so I stay at about 11.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards, already a little lower for both sides' recent bookings. Levante's draw with Elche leaves them one point above the drop, so the game matters, but Racing are mid-table and calm and no referee is named yet. Nothing the numbers can't see, so I stay at 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 33.6 shots, already lifted for Racing's busy recent games (+11.2% for their shooting). Levante's short rest could slow them a little, but Racing allow opponents to shoot freely (31 for Real Sociedad), so the two roughly cancel and I stay at about 34.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target, already lowered for Levante's poor recent accuracy (-4.5%) and raised for Racing's (+4.3%). I have taken Levante's blunt attack off goals already and do not count it again here, so I stay at 10.5.
